latin: Modus cognoscendi per ideas est ille cuius dixit Plato in Timeo paucos homines esse participes, sed bene deos omnes.
translation: The mode of knowing through ideas is that of which Plato said in the Timaeus that few men are participants, but indeed all the gods.
